Synthetic PDFs generated by `tool/generate_fixtures.py`:

- `valid.pdf`: three distinct page widths, 200/300/400 points.
- `too-many-pages.pdf`: 501 valid blank pages to exercise the source-page limit.
- `rotated.pdf`: first page has a pre-existing 90° rotation.
- `arabic.pdf`: shaped Arabic text, embedded Noto Sans Arabic (SIL OFL).
- `encrypted.pdf`: RC4 test fixture; password `test-password`.
- `empty-password.pdf`: encryption with an empty user password, to test rejection.
- `malformed.pdf`: plausible header/trailer with invalid structure.

Generated document content is dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0).
The embedded font retains its OFL license in `assets/licenses/Noto-OFL.txt`.
RC4 is only used to produce a compatibility rejection fixture, never by the app.
`fixtures.dart` embeds these exact bytes solely in test bundles.
